hero.subtitle: Create inspections, assign actions, manage sites, users, groups—everything from one smart platform designed for your frontline workforce.

heroFeatures.description: Our platform helps teams run safer, faster and more organized operations. Whether you're managing multiple sites, inspecting equipment, assigning tasks, or collaborating across teams—our digital tools bring everything into one simple dashboard and mobile app.

features.title: Easy to use for all teams

featureSection.description: Powerful features designed to streamline your operations and boost productivity

features.title: Create & Customize Dynamic Templates
features.description: Build inspection templates that fit your workflow—checklists, forms, safety audits, quality checks, and more. Duplicate, edit, and share them instantly with your team.

features.title: Conduct Inspections Anytime, Anywhere
features.description: Perform inspections directly from your mobile app or dashboard. Capture photos, notes, and ratings, then generate instant reports in one click.

features.title: Assign Actions & Track Progress
features.description: Found an issue? Assign it to the right person instantly. Track status, deadlines, and completion to ensure nothing is missed.

features.title: Manage Users With Smart Controls
features.description: Invite team members and assign roles based on responsibilities. Control exactly who can view, edit, or manage each part of your operations.

features.title: Organize Everything by Location
features.description: Manage inspections, issues, users, and activities by site. Ideal for businesses with multiple branches, stores, or job sites.

features.title: Collaborate Seamlessly With Teams
features.description: Create custom groups to streamline communication and workflows—maintenance, safety, quality teams, contractors, and more.

faq.description: Everything you need to know about our platform

questions.question: Is the platform available on both mobile and web?
questions.answer: Yes, you can access the dashboard on the web and perform inspections from both web and mobile apps.

questions.question: Can I customize my own templates?
questions.answer: Yes, you can create and customize templates to match your workflow. Build checklists, forms, safety audits, and more.

questions.question: How does user and role management work?
questions.answer: You can invite team members and assign roles with specific permissions. Control who can view, edit, or manage different parts of your operations.

questions.question: Do you offer a free trial?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer a free trial so you can explore all features and see how the platform fits your team before committing.

questions.question: Do you support multiple sites?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Organize inspections, users, and activities by location—perfect for companies with multiple branches or job sites.
